meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

copy.tagline: 从基因表达数据推断转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析RNA-seq数据来发现基因间的调控连接
copy.tagline_en: Infer transcription factor-target gene relationships from gene expression data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to discover regulatory interactions from RNA-seq data

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会调用 arboreto 从基因表达数据推断基因调控网络，识别转录因子调控哪些靶基因，输出含 TF、target、importance 的链接表。
howto.when: 当你分析转录组数据（如 bulk RNA-seq、单细胞 RNA-seq）想找转录因子—靶基因调控关系，或需要对大规模数据做分布式推断时触发。

say.text: 用 GRNBoost2 从这份表达数据推断调控网络
say.note: 会输出 TF、target、importance 的链接表

say.text: 按 importance 大于 0.5 过滤结果并保存
say.note: 留下高置信度调控链接

say.text: 比较 control 和 treatment 两种条件下的调控网络
say.note: 会分别推断再对照输出

howto.what_en: After install, Claude uses arboreto to infer gene regulatory networks from gene expression data, identifying which transcription factors regulate which target genes, and returns a link table with TF, target, and importance scores.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you analyze transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) hoping to identify transcription factor–target gene relationships, or when you need scalable distributed GRN inference for large datasets.

say_en.text: Run GRNBoost2 on this expression data and infer the regulatory network.
Filter the results to keep links with importance above 0.5 and save them.
Compare the regulatory networks between control and treatment conditions.
say_en.note: Runs inference for each condition separately.
